name: TRIBE Phnom Penh Post Office Square
short_description: A Green Key-certified lifestyle hotel near the Tonle Sap river and Royal Palace, with a 4.8/5 ALL rating from over 700 reviews.
ai_summary: TRIBE Phnom Penh Post Office Square sits centrally along the Tonle Sap river, close to the Royal Palace and Wat Phnom. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.8/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 729 reviews -- the highest guest rating found among Phnom Penh's Accor properties in this research. The hotel offers coworking spaces and meeting facilities, a pool, gym, five restaurants, a sky bar, and a spa, and is Green Key certified.
